transcript.text: From what you have described, the most likely cause is door interlock / switch (electrical start path). Is the handle/door physically broken or not closing, or does it close fine but the dryer still says the door is open?
the door closes fine, nothing broken. it dries ok but after it says End the drum keeps turning every couple of minutes

From what you have described, the most likely cause is drive motor. With the dryer unplugged and empty, turn the drum slowly by hand. Does it turn normally, does it feel stiff or stuck, or does it spin round very easily with no resistance at all?
im not sure how to check that, sorry. it turns fine when its running and it dries the clothes ok. it only does the turning after it says End
Does the motor hum/run without the drum turning, does the drum turn freely by hand, or is it stiff to turn by hand?
sorry I dont know how to check that. the drum turns fine when its running, no humming that I noticed. its only after End that it turns every few minutes
Run a short programme with a normal load. Is the drum turning now, or still not?
the drum turns fine when it's running. its only after it says End that it turns every few minutes, and it stops if I open the door
An overloaded drum or one big heavy item (a duvet or rug) can stop the drum turning. Was it overloaded or a single bulky item (and have you taken some out), or was it a normal load?
it was just a normal load, nothing bulky. the drum turns fine, its only after End that it keeps turning every few minutes

Coins, buttons, zips and hair grips are the usual cause. With the dryer unplugged, check the drum and its lifters, the lint filter and the slot it sits in, and turn the drum slowly while you listen. Did you find something (and have you removed it), can you see something stuck that won't come out, or is it all clear?
I haven't looked, sorry. The drum turns fine, its only after End that it turns every few minutes. Is that something to do with the dryer being faulty?

Probably not. Many dryers have an anti-crease feature that turns the drum every few minutes after End until the door is opened, which matches what you describe. What is the noise like - a squeal/chirp, a rhythmic thump, a scrape, or a rattle - and does the drum still turn?
just a short tumble sound every few minutes, no squeal or scrape. the drum does turn, then stops again. is that the anti-crease thing? how do I stop it?

Yes, a drum that turns briefly every few minutes only after End is shown, and stops when you open the door, is almost certainly the anti-crease feature. Opening the door ends it, as you've found. This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Most dryers turn the drum occasionally after the end of the programme (anti-crease) until the door is opened. It would be worth a closer look if it keeps heating after the end, or runs with the door open. Run a short programme. Has the noise gone, or is it still there?
